183:     pub fn new(

192:             slot@.key() == thread_id as nat,
193:         ensures

207:             batch_perms: None,
208:             slots: slot.get(),

211:         let atomic = CachePadded(
212:             AtomicU64::new(
213:                 Ghost((flat_combiner_instance, unbounded_log_instance, batch, Ghost(thread_id_g))),

215:                 Tracked(context_ghost),

221:                 atomic,

235:         requires

239:                 self.batch.0.id(),
240:                 self.flat_combiner_instance@,
241:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
242:             ),
243:             self.wf(self.thread_id_g@),
244:         ensures
245:             res.1@.enqueue_op_post(context_ghost@),
246:             res.1@.cell_id == self.batch.0.id(),
247:             self.wf(self.thread_id_g@),
248:     {
249:         let tracked FCClientRequestResponseGhost {
250:             batch_perms: batch_perms,
251:             cell_id,
252:             local_updates: local_updates,
253:             fc_clients: mut fc_clients,
254:         } = context_ghost.get();
255:         let tracked mut batch_perms = batch_perms.tracked_unwrap();
256:         let tracked local_updates = local_updates.tracked_unwrap();
257:         self.batch.0.put(Tracked(&mut batch_perms), PendingOperation::new(op));
258:         let tracked send_request_result;
259:         let res =
260:             atomic_with_ghost!(
261:             &self.atomic.0 => store(1);
262:             update prev->next;
263:             ghost g => {
264:                 let ghost tid = fc_clients.key();
265:                 let ghost rid = local_updates.key();
266: 
267:                 self.flat_combiner_instance.borrow().pre_send_request(tid, &fc_clients, &g.slots);
268:                 send_request_result = self.flat_combiner_instance.borrow().send_request(tid, rid, fc_clients, g.slots);
269:                 fc_clients = send_request_result.0.get();
270: 
271:                 g.slots = send_request_result.1.get();
272:                 g.batch_perms = Some(batch_perms);
273:                 g.update = Some(local_updates);
274: 
275:                 assert(g.inv(1, tid, self.batch.0, self.flat_combiner_instance.view(), self.unbounded_log_instance.view()))
276:             }
277:         );
278:         let tracked new_context_ghost = FCClientRequestResponseGhost {
279:             batch_perms: None,
280:             cell_id,
281:             local_updates: None,
282:             fc_clients,
283:         };
284:         (true, Tracked(new_context_ghost))
285:     }

287:     pub fn dequeue_response(
288:         &self,
289:         context_ghost: Tracked<FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>>,
290:     ) -> (res: (Option<DT::Response>, Tracked<FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>>))

292:             context_ghost@.dequeue_resp_pre(
293:                 self.batch.0.id(),
294:                 self.thread_id_g@,
295:                 self.flat_combiner_instance@,
296:             ),
297:             self.wf(self.thread_id_g@),

299:             res.1@.dequeue_resp_post(context_ghost@, res.0, self.unbounded_log_instance@),
300:             self.wf(self.thread_id_g@),
301:     {
302:         let tracked FCClientRequestResponseGhost {
303:             batch_perms: mut batch_perms,
304:             cell_id,
305:             local_updates: mut local_updates,
306:             fc_clients: mut fc_clients,
307:         } = context_ghost.get();
308:         let tracked recv_response_result;
309:         let res =
310:             atomic_with_ghost!(
311:             &self.atomic.0 => load();
312:             returning res;
313:             ghost g => {
314:                 if res == 0 {
315:                     batch_perms = g.batch_perms;
316:                     local_updates = g.update;

318:                     let tid = fc_clients.key();
319:                     let rid = fc_clients.value().get_Waiting_0();
320:                     self.flat_combiner_instance.borrow().pre_recv_response(tid, &fc_clients, &g.slots);
321:                     recv_response_result = self.flat_combiner_instance.borrow().recv_response(tid, rid, fc_clients, g.slots);
322:                     fc_clients = recv_response_result.0.get();
323: 
324:                     g.slots = recv_response_result.1.get();
325:                     g.batch_perms = None;
326:                     g.update = None;
327:                 }
328:             }
329:         );
330:         if res == 0 {

332:             let op = self.batch.0.take(Tracked(&mut batch_perms));
333:             let resp = op.resp.unwrap();

335:                 batch_perms: Some(batch_perms),

337:                 local_updates,
338:                 fc_clients,
339:             };

342:             let tracked new_context_ghost = FCClientRequestResponseGhost {
343:                 batch_perms,
344:                 cell_id,
345:                 local_updates,
346:                 fc_clients,

359: struct_with_invariants!{
360: pub tracked struct ContextGhost<DT: Dispatch> {
361:     pub batch_perms: Option<PointsTo<PendingOperation<DT>>>,
362: 
363:     pub slots: FlatCombiner::slots,
364: 
365:     pub update: Option<UnboundedLog::local_updates<DT>>
366: }
367: 
368: pub open spec fn inv(&self, v: u64, tid: nat, cell: PCell<PendingOperation<DT>>, fc: FlatCombiner::Instance, inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>) -> bool {
369:     predicate {
370:         &&& self.slots.key() == tid
371:         &&& self.slots.instance_id() == fc.id()
372: 
373:         &&& ((v == 0) || (v == 1))
374:         &&& (v == 0 ==> self.slots.value().is_Empty() || self.slots.value().is_Response())
375:         &&& (v == 1 ==> self.slots.value().is_Request() || self.slots.value().is_InProgress())
376: 
377:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Empty() ==> {
378:             &&& self.update.is_none()
379:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
380:         })
381: 
382:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Request() ==> {
383:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
384:             &&& update.value().is_Init()
385:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
386:             &&& update.instance_id() == inst.id()
387: 
388:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
389:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
390:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == cell.id()
391:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().value().op == update.value().get_Init_op()
392:         })
393: 
394:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_InProgress() ==> {
395:             &&& self.update.is_none()
396:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
397:         })
398: 
399:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Response() ==> {
400:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
401:             &&& update.value().is_Done()
402:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
403:             &&& update.instance_id() == inst.id()
404: 
405:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
406:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
407:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == cell.id()
408:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().value().resp matches Some(resp)
409:             &&& resp == update.value().get_Done_ret()
410:         })
411:     }
412: }
413: }

416: pub tracked struct FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT: Dispatch> {
417:     pub tracked batch_perms: Option<PointsTo<PendingOperation<DT>>>,
418:     pub tracked cell_id: Ghost<CellId>,
419:     pub tracked local_updates: Option<UnboundedLog::local_updates<DT>>,
420:     pub tracked fc_clients: FlatCombiner::clients,
421: }
422: 
423: impl<DT: Dispatch> FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT> {
424:     pub open spec fn enqueue_op_pre(
425:         &self,
426:         tid: nat,
427:         op: DT::WriteOperation,
428:         batch_cell: CellId,
429:         fc_inst: FlatCombiner::Instance,
430:         inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>,
431:     ) -> bool {
432:         &&& self.local_updates matches Some(local_updates)
433:         &&& local_updates.instance_id() == inst.id()
434:         &&& local_updates.value().is_Init()
435:         &&& local_updates.value().get_Init_op() == op
436:         &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
437:         &&& batch_perms@.pcell == self.cell_id
438:         &&& self.cell_id == batch_cell
439:         &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_uninit()
440:         &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == fc_inst.id()
441:         &&& self.fc_clients.key() == tid
442:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Idle()
443:     }
444: 
445:     pub open spec fn enqueue_op_post(&self, pre: FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>) -> bool
446:         recommends
447:             pre.local_updates.is_some(),
448:     {
449:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Waiting()
450:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().get_Waiting_0() == pre.local_updates.unwrap().key()
451:         &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == pre.fc_clients.instance_id()
452:         &&& self.fc_clients.key() == pre.fc_clients.key()
453:         &&& self.cell_id == pre.cell_id
454:         &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
455:         &&& self.local_updates.is_none()
456:     }
457: 
458:     pub open spec fn dequeue_resp_pre(
459:         &self,
460:         batch_cell: CellId,
461:         tid: nat,
462:         fc_inst: FlatCombiner::Instance,
463:     ) -> bool {
464:         &&& self.fc_clients.key() == tid
465:         &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == fc_inst.id()
466:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Waiting()
467:         &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
468:         &&& self.local_updates.is_none()
469:         &&& self.cell_id == batch_cell
470:     }
471: 
472:     pub open spec fn dequeue_resp_post(
473:         &self,
474:         pre: FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>,
475:         ret: Option<DT::Response>,
476:         inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>,
477:     ) -> bool {
478:         &&& ret matches Some(ret) ==> {
479:             &&& self.cell_id == pre.cell_id
480:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
481:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_uninit()
482:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == self.cell_id
483:             &&& self.local_updates matches Some(local_updates)
484:             &&& local_updates.instance_id() == inst.id()
485:             &&& local_updates.value().is_Done()
486:             &&& local_updates.key() == pre.fc_clients.value().get_Waiting_0()
487:             &&& local_updates.value().get_Done_ret() == ret
488:             &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == pre.fc_clients.instance_id()
489:             &&& self.fc_clients.key() == pre.fc_clients.key()
490:             &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Idle()
491:         }
492:         &&& ret.is_none() ==> {
493:             &&& self == pre
494:         }
495:     }
496: }
497: 
498: }

579:     pub                    local_versions: Vec<CachePadded<AtomicU64<_, (UnboundedLog::local_versions<DT>, CyclicBuffer::local_versions<DT>), _>>>,

587: pub open spec fn wf(&self) -> bool {
588:     predicate {
589:         &&& 0 < self.num_replicas@ <=  MAX_REPLICAS
590: 
591:         &&& self.local_versions.len() == self.num_replicas
592: 
593:         &&& self.slog.len() == LOG_SIZE
594:         &&& self.slog.len() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.buffer_size()
595:         &&& self.slog.len() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.cell_ids().len()
596:         &&& (forall |i| #![trigger self.slog[i]] 0 <= i < self.slog.len() ==> {
597:             &&& self.slog[i].log_entry.id() == (#[trigger]self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.cell_ids()[i])
598:         })
599: 
600:         &&& (forall |i: nat| i < LOG_SIZE ==> (#[trigger] self.slog[i as int]).wf(i, self.cyclic_buffer_instance@))
601: 
602:         &&& self.unbounded_log_instance@.num_replicas() == self.num_replicas
603:         &&& self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.num_replicas() == self.num_replicas
604:         &&& self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.unbounded_log_instance() == self.unbounded_log_instance
605:     }
606: 
607:     invariant on version_upper_bound with (unbounded_log_instance) specifically (self.version_upper_bound.0) is (v: u64, g: UnboundedLog::version_upper_bound<DT>) {
608:         &&& g.instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance@.id()
609:         &&& g.value() == v
610:         &&& 0 <= v <= MAX_IDX
611:     }
612: 
613:     invariant on head with (cyclic_buffer_instance) specifically (self.head.0) is (v: u64, g: CyclicBuffer::head<DT>) {
614:         &&& g.instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance@.id()
615:         &&& g.value() == v
616:         &&& 0 <= v <= MAX_IDX
617:     }
618: 
619:     invariant on tail with (cyclic_buffer_instance, unbounded_log_instance) specifically (self.tail.0) is (v: u64, g: (UnboundedLog::tail<DT>, CyclicBuffer::tail<DT>)) {
620:         &&& g.0.instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance@.id()
621:         &&& g.0.value() == v
622:         &&& g.1.instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance@.id()
623:         &&& g.1.value() == v
624:         &&& 0 <= v <= MAX_IDX
625:     }
626: 
627:     invariant on local_versions with (unbounded_log_instance, cyclic_buffer_instance)
628:         forall |i: int|
629:         where (0 <= i < self.local_versions@.len())
630:         specifically (self.local_versions@[i].0)
631:         is (v: u64, g: (UnboundedLog::local_versions<DT>, CyclicBuffer::local_versions<DT>)) {
632: 
633:         &&& g.0.instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance@.id()
634:         &&& g.0.key() == i
635:         &&& g.0.value() == v
636:         &&& g.1.instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance@.id()
637:         &&& g.1.key() == i
638:         &&& g.1.value() == v
639:         &&& 0 <= v <= MAX_IDX
640:     }
641: }
642: }

645: impl<DT: Dispatch> NrLog<DT> {
646:     pub fn new(num_replicas: usize, log_size: usize) -> (res: (
647:         Self,
648:         Vec<ReplicaToken>,
649:         Tracked<NrLogTokens<DT>>,
650:     ))
651:         requires
652:             log_size == LOG_SIZE,
653:             0 < num_replicas && num_replicas <= MAX_REPLICAS,
654:         ensures
655:             res.0.wf(),
656:             res.0.unbounded_log_instance@ == res.2@.unbounded_log_instance,
657:             res.0.cyclic_buffer_instance@ == res.2@.cyclic_buffer_instance,
658:             res.1.len() == num_replicas,
659:             forall|i| #![trigger res.1[i]] 0 <= i < num_replicas ==> res.1[i].id_spec() == i,
660:             res.2@.wf(num_replicas as nat),
661:     {
662:         let tracked unbounded_log_instance: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>;
663:         let tracked ul_tail: UnboundedLog::tail<DT>;
664:         let tracked ul_replicas: Map<NodeId, UnboundedLog::replicas<DT>>;
665:         let tracked mut ul_local_versions: Map<NodeId, UnboundedLog::local_versions<DT>>;
666:         let tracked ul_version_upper_bound: UnboundedLog::version_upper_bound<DT>;
667:         let tracked ul_combiner: Map<NodeId, UnboundedLog::combiner<DT>>;
668:         proof {
669:             let tracked (
670:                 Tracked(unbounded_log_instance0),  
671:                 Tracked(ul_log0),  
672:                 Tracked(ul_tail0),  
673:                 Tracked(ul_replicas0),  
674:                 Tracked(ul_local_versions0),  
675:                 Tracked(ul_version_upper_bound0),  
676:                 _,  
677:                 _,  
678:                 Tracked(ul_combiner0),  
679:             ) = UnboundedLog::Instance::initialize(num_replicas as nat);
680:             unbounded_log_instance = unbounded_log_instance0;
681:             ul_tail = ul_tail0;
682:             ul_replicas = ul_replicas0.into_map();
683:             ul_local_versions = ul_local_versions0.into_map();
684:             ul_version_upper_bound = ul_version_upper_bound0;
685:             ul_combiner = ul_combiner0.into_map();
686:         }
687:         let ghost mut logical_log_idx;
688:         proof {
689:             logical_log_idx = -log_size as int;
690:         }
691:         let mut slog_entries: Vec<Option<PCell<Option<ConcreteLogEntry<DT>>>>> = Vec::with_capacity(
692:             log_size,
693:         );
694:         let ghost mut cell_ids: Seq<CellId> = Seq::empty();
695:         let tracked mut contents: Map<LogicalLogIdx, StoredType<DT>> = Map::tracked_empty();
696:         let mut log_idx = 0;
697:         while log_idx < log_size
698:             invariant
699:                 0 <= log_idx <= log_size,
700:                 log_size == LOG_SIZE,
701:                 logical_log_idx == log_idx - log_size,
702:                 -log_size <= logical_log_idx <= 0,
703:                 slog_entries.len() == log_idx,
704:                 cell_ids.len() == log_idx,
705:                 forall|i| 0 <= i < log_idx ==> (#[trigger] slog_entries[i]).is_some(),
706:                 forall|i|
707:                     0 <= i < log_idx ==> #[trigger] cell_ids[i] == (
708:                     #[trigger] slog_entries[i]).unwrap().id(),
709:                 forall|i| -log_size <= i < logical_log_idx <==> #[trigger] contents.contains_key(i),
710:                 forall|i| #[trigger]
711:                     contents.contains_key(i) ==> stored_type_inv(
712:                         contents[i],
713:                         i,
714:                         cell_ids[log_entry_idx(i, log_size as nat) as int],
715:                         unbounded_log_instance,
716:                     ),
717:             decreases log_size - log_idx
718:         {
719:             let (pcell, token) = PCell::new(Option::None);
720:             proof {
721:                 cell_ids = cell_ids.push(pcell.id());
722:             }
723:             slog_entries.push(Option::Some(pcell));
724:             let tracked stored_type = StoredType {
725:                 cell_perms: token.get(),
726:                 log_entry: Option::None,
727:             };
728:             proof {
729:                 contents.tracked_insert(logical_log_idx, stored_type);
730:             }
731:             log_idx = log_idx + 1;
732:             proof {
733:                 logical_log_idx = logical_log_idx + 1;
734:             }
735:         }
736: 
737:         let tracked cyclic_buffer_instance: CyclicBuffer::Instance<DT>;
738:         let tracked cb_head: CyclicBuffer::head<DT>;
739:         let tracked cb_tail: CyclicBuffer::tail<DT>;
740:         let tracked mut cb_local_versions: Map<NodeId, CyclicBuffer::local_versions<DT>>;
741:         let tracked mut cb_alive_bits: Map<LogIdx, CyclicBuffer::alive_bits<DT>>;
742:         let tracked cb_combiners: Map<NodeId, CyclicBuffer::combiner<DT>>;
743:         proof {
744:             let tracked (
745:                 Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance0),  
746:                 Tracked(cb_head0),  
747:                 Tracked(cb_tail0),  
748:                 Tracked(cb_local_versions0),  
749:                 Tracked(cb_alive_bits0),  
750:                 Tracked(cb_combiner0),  
751:             ) = CyclicBuffer::Instance::initialize(
752:                 log_size as nat,
753:                 num_replicas as nat,
754:                 contents,
755:                 cell_ids,
756:                 unbounded_log_instance,
757:                 contents,
758:             );
759:             cyclic_buffer_instance = cyclic_buffer_instance0;
760:             cb_head = cb_head0;
761:             cb_tail = cb_tail0;
762:             cb_local_versions = cb_local_versions0.into_map();
763:             cb_alive_bits = cb_alive_bits0.into_map();
764:             cb_combiners = cb_combiner0.into_map();
765:         }
766:         let mut slog: Vec<BufferEntry<DT>> = Vec::with_capacity(log_size);
767:         let mut log_idx = 0;
768:         while log_idx < log_size
769:             invariant
770:                 0 <= log_idx <= log_size,
771:                 slog_entries.len() == log_size,
772:                 slog.len() == log_idx,
773:                 cell_ids.len() == log_size,
774:                 forall|i|
775:                     #![trigger slog[i]]
776:                     0 <= i < log_idx ==> {
777:                         &&& slog[i].wf(i as nat, cyclic_buffer_instance)
778:                         &&& slog[i].log_entry.id() == (#[trigger] cell_ids[i])
779:                     },
780:                 forall|i| log_idx <= i < log_size ==> cb_alive_bits.contains_key(i),
781:                 forall|i|
782:                     #![trigger cb_alive_bits[i]]
783:                     log_idx <= i < log_size ==> {
784:                         &&& cb_alive_bits[i].key() == i
785:                         &&& cb_alive_bits[i].value() == false
786:                         &&& cb_alive_bits[i].instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance.id()
787:                     },
788:                 forall|i| 0 <= i < log_idx ==> slog_entries.spec_index(i).is_none(),
789:                 forall|i|
790:                     #![trigger slog_entries[i]]
791:                     log_idx <= i < log_size ==> {
792:                         &&& slog_entries[i] matches Some(entry)
793:                         &&& entry.id() == cell_ids[i]
794:                     },
795:             decreases log_size - log_idx
796:         {
797:             let tracked cb_alive_bit;
798:             proof {
799:                 cb_alive_bit = cb_alive_bits.tracked_remove(log_idx as nat);
800:             }
801:             let mut log_entry = Option::None;
802:             slog_entries.set_and_swap(log_idx, &mut log_entry);
803:             assert(log_entry.is_some());
804:             let log_entry = log_entry.unwrap();
805:             let cb_inst = Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone());
806:             let entry = BufferEntry {
807:                 log_entry: log_entry,
808:                 alive: AtomicBool::new(
809:                     Ghost((Ghost(log_idx as nat), cb_inst)),
810:                     false,
811:                     Tracked(cb_alive_bit),
812:                 ),
813:                 cyclic_buffer_idx: Ghost(log_idx as nat),
814:                 cyclic_buffer_instance: Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone()),
815:             };
816:             slog.push(entry);
817:             log_idx = log_idx + 1;
818:         }
819:         let ul_inst = Tracked(unbounded_log_instance.clone());
820:         let version_upper_bound = CachePadded(
821:             AtomicU64::new(Ghost(ul_inst), 0, Tracked(ul_version_upper_bound)),
822:         );
823:         let cb_inst = Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone());
824:         let head = CachePadded(AtomicU64::new(Ghost(cb_inst), 0, Tracked(cb_head)));
825:         let cb_inst = Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone());
826:         let ul_inst = Tracked(unbounded_log_instance.clone());
827:         let tail = CachePadded(
828:             AtomicU64::new(Ghost((cb_inst, ul_inst)), 0, Tracked((ul_tail, cb_tail))),
829:         );
830:         let mut local_versions: Vec<
831:             CachePadded<
832:                 AtomicU64<
833:                     (Tracked<UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>>, Tracked<CyclicBuffer::Instance<DT>>, int),
834:                     (UnboundedLog::local_versions<DT>, CyclicBuffer::local_versions<DT>),
835:                     _,
836:                 >,
837:             >,
838:         > = Vec::with_capacity(num_replicas);
839:         let mut nid = 0;
840:         while nid < num_replicas
841:             invariant
842:                 0 <= nid <= num_replicas,
843:                 local_versions.len() == nid,
844:                 forall|i| nid <= i < num_replicas ==> ul_local_versions.contains_key(i),
845:                 forall|i| nid <= i < num_replicas ==> cb_local_versions.contains_key(i),
846:                 forall|i|
847:                     #![trigger cb_local_versions[i]]
848:                     nid <= i < num_replicas ==> {
849:                         &&& cb_local_versions[i].instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance.id()
850:                         &&& cb_local_versions[i].key() == i
851:                         &&& cb_local_versions[i].value() == 0
852:                     },
853:                 forall|i|
854:                     #![trigger ul_local_versions[i]]
855:                     nid <= i < num_replicas ==> {
856:                         &&& ul_local_versions[i].instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance.id()
857:                         &&& ul_local_versions[i].key() == i
858:                         &&& ul_local_versions[i].value() == 0
859:                     },
860:                 forall|i: int|
861:                     #![trigger local_versions[i]]
862:                     0 <= i < local_versions.len() ==> {
863:                         &&& local_versions[i].0.well_formed()
864:                         &&& local_versions[i].0.constant().0 == unbounded_log_instance
865:                         &&& local_versions[i].0.constant().1 == cyclic_buffer_instance
866:                         &&& local_versions[i].0.constant().2 == i
867:                     },
868:             decreases num_replicas - nid
869:         {
870:             let ghost mut nid_ghost;
871:             let tracked ul_version;
872:             let tracked cb_version;
873:             proof {
874:                 nid_ghost = nid as int;
875:                 ul_version = ul_local_versions.tracked_remove(nid as nat);
876:                 cb_version = cb_local_versions.tracked_remove(nid as nat);
877:             }
878:             let cb_inst = Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone());
879:             let ul_inst = Tracked(unbounded_log_instance.clone());
880:             local_versions.push(
881:                 CachePadded(
882:                     AtomicU64::new(
883:                         Ghost((ul_inst, cb_inst, nid_ghost)),
884:                         0,
885:                         Tracked((ul_version, cb_version)),
886:                     ),
887:                 ),
888:             );
889:             nid = nid + 1;
890:         }
891: 
892:         let mut replica_tokens: Vec<ReplicaToken> = Vec::with_capacity(num_replicas);
893:         let mut idx = 0;
894:         while idx < num_replicas
895:             invariant
896:                 0 <= idx <= num_replicas,
897:                 num_replicas <= MAX_REPLICAS,
898:                 replica_tokens.len() == idx,
899:                 forall|i|
900:                     #![trigger replica_tokens[i]]
901:                     0 <= i < idx ==> replica_tokens[i].id_spec() == i,
902:             decreases num_replicas - idx
903:         {
904:             replica_tokens.push(ReplicaToken::new(idx as ReplicaId));
905:             idx = idx + 1;
906:         }
907:         let ghost mut num_replicas_ghost;
908:         proof { num_replicas_ghost = num_replicas as nat }
909:         ;
910:         let tracked config = NrLogTokens {
911:             num_replicas: num_replicas_ghost,
912:             replicas: ul_replicas,
913:             combiners: ul_combiner,
914:             cb_combiners,
915:             unbounded_log_instance: unbounded_log_instance.clone(),
916:             cyclic_buffer_instance: cyclic_buffer_instance.clone(),
917:         };
918:         let log = NrLog {
919:             slog,
920:             version_upper_bound,
921:             head,
922:             tail,
923:             local_versions,
924:             num_replicas: Ghost(num_replicas as nat),
925:             unbounded_log_instance: Tracked(unbounded_log_instance),
926:             cyclic_buffer_instance: Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance),
927:         };
928:         (log, replica_tokens, Tracked(config))
929:     }

970:     pub(crate) fn get_version_upper_bound(
971:         &self,
972:         local_reads: Tracked<UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>>,
973:     ) -> (ret: (u64, Tracked<UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>>))
974:         requires
975:             self.wf(),
976:             local_reads@.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
977:             local_reads@.value().is_Init(),
978:         ensures
979:             ret.1@.value().is_VersionUpperBound(),
980:             ret.1@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_version_upper_bound() == ret.0 as nat,
981:             ret.1@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_op() == local_reads@.value().get_Init_op(),
982:             ret.1@.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
983:             ret.1@.key() == local_reads@.key(),
984:     {
985:         let tracked local_reads = local_reads.get();
986:         let ghost rid = local_reads.key();
987:         let tracked new_local_reads_g: UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>;
988:         let res =
989:             atomic_with_ghost!(
990:             &self.version_upper_bound.0 => load();
991:             returning res;
992:             ghost g => {
993:                 new_local_reads_g = self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow()
994:                                             .readonly_version_upper_bound(rid, &g, local_reads);
995:             }
996:         );
997:         (res, Tracked(new_local_reads_g))
998:     }

1002:         node_id: ReplicaId,
1003:         version_upper_bound: u64,

1007:             self.wf(),
1008:             node_id < self.local_versions.len(),
1009:             local_reads@.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
1010:             local_reads@.value().is_VersionUpperBound(),
1011:             local_reads@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_version_upper_bound() == version_upper_bound,
1012:         ensures
1013:             result.0 ==> result.1@.value().is_ReadyToRead(),
1014:             result.0 ==> result.1@.value().get_ReadyToRead_node_id() == node_id,
1015:             result.0 ==> result.1@.value().get_ReadyToRead_op()
1016:                 == local_reads@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_op(),
1017:             !result.0 ==> result.1 == local_reads,
1018:             result.1@.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
1019:             result.1@.key() == local_reads@.key(),
1020:     {

1031:                         .borrow()

1033:                 } else {
1034:                     local_reads.get()
1035:                 };
1036:             }

1041:     proof fn unbounded_log_append_entries(
1042:         tracked &self,
1043:         nid: nat,
1044:         ridx: nat,
1045:         tracked state: AppendEntriesGhostState<DT>,
1046:     ) -> (tracked ret: AppendEntriesGhostState<DT>)

1048:             self.wf(),
1049:             state.idx == 0,
1050:             state.wf(nid, ridx, self.unbounded_log_instance@),
1051:         ensures
1052:             ret.request_ids == state.request_ids,
1053:             ret.operations == state.operations,
1054:             ret.idx == ridx + 1,
1055:             ret.old_tail == state.old_tail,
1056:             ret.wf(nid, ridx, self.unbounded_log_instance@),
1057:         decreases ridx,
1058:     {
1059:         let tracked mut state = state;
1060:         if ridx != 0 {
1061:             state = self.unbounded_log_append_entries(nid, (ridx - 1) as nat, state);
1062:         }
1063:         let tracked AppendEntriesGhostState {
1064:             idx,
1065:             old_tail,
1066:             mut log_entries,
1067:             mut local_updates,
1068:             combiner,
1069:             mut tail,
1070:             request_ids,
1071:             operations,
1072:         } = state;
1073:         let reqid = request_ids[ridx as int];
1074:         let tracked local_update = local_updates.tracked_remove(ridx);
1075:         let tracked update_result =
1076:             self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().update_place_ops_in_log_one(
1077:             nid as nat,
1078:             reqid,
1079:             &mut tail,
1080:             local_update,
1081:             combiner,

1083:         let tracked combiner = update_result.2.get();
1084:         log_entries.tracked_insert(ridx, update_result.0.get());
1085:         local_updates.tracked_insert(ridx, update_result.1.get());
1086:         let tracked res = AppendEntriesGhostState {
1087:             idx: idx + 1,
1088:             old_tail,
1089:             log_entries,
1090:             local_updates,
1091:             combiner,

1906:     pub(crate) fn find_min_local_version(
1907:         &self,
1908:         cb_combiner: Tracked<CyclicBuffer::combiner<DT>>,
1909:     ) -> (result: (u64, Tracked<CyclicBuffer::combiner<DT>>))
1910:         requires
1911:             self.wf(),
1912:             cb_combiner@.instance_id() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.id(),
1913:             cb_combiner@.value().is_Idle(),
1914:         ensures
1915:             result.0 <= MAX_IDX,
1916:             result.1@.key() == cb_combiner@.key(),
1917:             result.1@.value().is_AdvancingHead(),
1918:             result.1@.instance_id() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.id(),
1919:             result.1@.value().get_AdvancingHead_idx() == self.num_replicas,
1920:             result.1@.value().get_AdvancingHead_min_local_version() == result.0,
1921:     {
1922:         let num_replicas = self.local_versions.len();
1923:         let tracked mut g_cb_comb_new: CyclicBuffer::combiner<DT> = cb_combiner.get();
1924:         let ghost g_node_id = cb_combiner@.key();
1925:         let mut min_local_version =
1926:             atomic_with_ghost!(
1927:             &self.local_versions[0].0 => load();
1928:             returning ret;
1929:             ghost g => {
1930:                 g_cb_comb_new = self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow()
1931:                                         .advance_head_start(g_node_id, &g.1, g_cb_comb_new);
1932:             });
1933:         let mut idx: usize = 1;
1934:         while idx < num_replicas
1935:             invariant
1936:                 self.wf(),
1937:                 0 <= idx <= num_replicas,
1938:                 min_local_version <= MAX_IDX,
1939:                 g_cb_comb_new.instance_id() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.id(),
1940:                 g_cb_comb_new.value().is_AdvancingHead(),
1941:                 g_cb_comb_new.value().get_AdvancingHead_idx() == idx,
1942:                 g_cb_comb_new.value().get_AdvancingHead_min_local_version() == min_local_version,
1943:                 g_cb_comb_new.key() == g_node_id,
1944:                 num_replicas == self.local_versions.len(),
1945:             decreases num_replicas - idx
1946:         {
1947:             let cur_local_tail =
1948:                 atomic_with_ghost!(
1949:                 &self.local_versions[idx].0 => load();
1950:                 returning ret;
1951:                 ghost g => {
1952:                     g_cb_comb_new = self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow()
1953:                                             .advance_head_next(g_node_id, &g.1, g_cb_comb_new);
1954:                 });
1955:             if cur_local_tail < min_local_version {
1956:                 min_local_version = cur_local_tail;
1957:             }
1958:             idx = idx + 1;
1959:         }
1960:         (min_local_version, Tracked(g_cb_comb_new))
1961:     }
1962: }

1981:         data: DT::View,
1982:         inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>,

1990:         &&& self.ghost_replica@.key() == nid

1992:         &&& self.ghost_replica@.value() == data
1993:         &&& self.combiner@.key() == nid

1995:         &&& self.cb_combiner@.key() == nid
1996:         &&& self.cb_combiner@.instance_id() == cb_inst.id()
